text: At its meeting on December 17 and 18, 2019, City Council adopted MM13.19 to authorize the General Manager, Transportation Services to negotiate, enter into and execute an agreement, or separate agreements, with either, each or all of 65 King East LP and/or its design consultants and/or construction contractors as the case may be, to design and construct streetscape improvements to City standards for Colborne Street between Church Street and Leader Lane, and Leader Lane between King Street East and Colborne Street. Since that time the developer has expressed interest in expanding the scope of the proposed improvements to include Colborne Lane (an 'L' shaped laneway connecting Colborne Street and Leader Lane) and the south section of Leader Lane between Colborne Street and Wellington Street East.
